rules.message: The host ships empty — installNetworkRetry() renders into it; the server never does (there is no server response to render from).
Do not put aria-live on the host — the behavior gives the rendered alert role="status" itself; doubling up causes double announcements.
No declared timeout found (data-hx-request '{"timeout": …}') — without one (or htmx.config.timeout) only hard send failures fire; slow-network hangs go unsurfaced.
A retried POST is a double-submit risk without a server-side key — pair mutating forms with the idempotency-key recipe (the retry re-collects the same hidden key).
